title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager MyResolveEventHandler Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Endpoint Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the MyResolveEventHandler method. The issue results from loading a library from an untrusted location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
